LESSON: : OUR SCHOOL

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: : OUR SCHOOL

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about : OUR SCHOOL. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What are the colours of the flag?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Appreciate the work done by people in school,
2. Identify structures found in the school for familiarization 118
3. Identify the flag and the flag post for patriotism. school about our school colour the flag pictures or videos depicting structure and people in the school.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Appreciate the work done by people in school,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the work done by people in school,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Identify structures found in the school for familiarization 118
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify structures found in the school for familiarization 118. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Identify the flag and the flag post for patriotism. school about our school colour the flag pictures or videos depicting structure and people in the school.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify the flag and the flag post for patriotism. school about our school colour the flag pictures or videos depicting structure and people in the school. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about : OUR SCHOOL.
2. Explain : OUR SCHOOL to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand : OUR SCHOOL.
4. Show that you can: Appreciate the work done by people in school,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about : OUR SCHOOL. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: What are the colours of the flag?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Appreciate the work done by people in school,
2. Identify structures found in the school for familiarization 118
3. Identify the flag and the flag post for patriotism. school about our school colour the flag pictures or videos depicting structure and people in the school.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
